data.note: PR #14 (feat/maintenance-whatsapp-alerts @ 5e75749, based on main a2ae41c). New Alerts tab: rules of the form "equipment out of order → WhatsApp to name/number". New maintenance tickets are matched by keyword and queue one message per (ticket, rule) via the existing whatsapp_delivery bridge; validate_job is chained (alert-* jobs are checked by alert_rules, others by order_confirmations). The bridge now also exists without OFFICE_ORDER_* (OFFICE_WHATSAPP_ALERTS=0 to disable). 208 agent tests plus web check/build pass. Noah: please test on your paired bridge. Add a Toalett rule with your own number in the dashboard, then report "toalettet er tett".
